stories.title: Pakistan condemns targeting of Aramco building, demands Houthis cease all attacks against Saudi Arabia
stories.brief: Pakistan on Monday condemned the Houthi attack on Saudi oil giant Aramco’s corporate office in Riyadh, demanding that the rebel group “immediately and unconditionally” cease all attacks against Saudi Arabia, the Foreign Office (FO) said.

stories.title: Pakistan condemns Houthi attack on Saudi Aramco building, denounces targeting of civilian facilities
stories.brief: Pakistan on Monday condemned the attempted attack by the Houthis on a Saudi Aramco building in Riyadh, while expressing concern over the targeting of civilian facilities. In a statement on X, the Foreign Office (FO) said: "Pakistan strongly condemns the attempted attack by the Houthis on a Saudi Aramco administrative building in Riyadh.

stories.title: The superpower battle over energy – and what it means for your bills
stories.brief: A tug-of-war between China and the US could have a big impact on energy costs, but who will win?

stories.title: Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy
stories.brief: The US president said he spoke with Jensen Huang on Monday and asked him about the affair with the alleged spy.

stories.title: What we know so far about Jensen Huang's affair with suspected Chinese spy
stories.brief: The billionaire tech executive finds himself mired in a personal and national security scandal.

stories.brief: The share price dropped wiped hundreds of billions of dollars from the value of Nvidia.

stories.title: JUI-F’s Deputy Chief Qari Iftikhar taken into custody, says party spokesperson
stories.brief: Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam-Fazl (JUI-F) Deputy Chief Qari Iftikhar has allegedly been taken into custody by unidentified individuals, the party's spokesperson said on Monday. The arrest comes amid growing tensions between the government and the JUI-F following the imposition of governor’s rule in Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa.

stories.title: UK actor Russell Brand sentenced to 10-and-a-half years in jail for rape, sexual assault
stories.brief: Comedian Russell Brand, once one of Britain's most high-profile broadcasters and a Hollywood star, was jailed for 10-and-a-half years on Monday after he was convicted of raping one woman and sexually ​assaulting three more around two decades ago.

stories.title: Trump 'Board of Peace' says Israel too slow as floods ravage Gaza
stories.brief: President Donald Trump's "Board of Peace" said Monday that Israel needed to act immediately to help war-battered Gaza cope with impending winter, saying measures ahead of deadly floods had been insufficient. Israel has taken a biting tone against Hamas over the floods, saying the militant group should have invested in infrastructure instead of weaponry.

stories.title: TTAP calls for immediate end to violence, resumption of talks to quell AJK unrest
stories.brief: The statement comes as Rawalakot is currently gripped by unrest amid alleged clashes between security forces and supporters of the proscribed Joint Awami Action Committee (JAAC) rights group, with casualties reported. Preventing further bloodshed, ensuring justice for those killed and resolving public demands through negotiations are the government's immediate responsibilities,” the statement said.

stories.title: PM directs foreign ministry to urgently ‘escalate humanitarian assistance’ for rain-hit Gaza
stories.brief: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif said on Monday he had directed the foreign ministry to pursue all possible means to urgently “escalate humanitarian assistance” to Gaza, where heavy rains have flooded tens of thousands of tents housing displaced Palestinians.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz directs MoFA to step up humanitarian aid to Gaza
stories.brief: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Monday directed the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA) to pursue "all possible means" to step up urgent humanitarian assistance to Gaza, and condemned Israel’s continued restrictions on aid and violations of the ceasefire and international law.

stories.title: Zoe Kleinman: Nvidia CEO's affair will cause ripples across US and beyond
stories.brief: Jensen Huang is being investigated by his own company over an extramarital affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy.
